title: Gotcha | Samosa-AI
excerpt: Gotcha is a fully on-device AI copilot for Android — control your phone with natural language through 100+ device tools, dual safety modes, and voice calls over any app.
content_html:
On-device Android copilot · Available now

Say it.
Gotcha does it.

Most AI projects talk — Gotcha acts. A fully on-device AI copilot for Android that turns natural language into real device actions across 100+ tools, keeping you in total control.

  • Runs completely on your phone
  • Bring your own model (local or cloud)
  • Free Samosa AI credits to start
  • Android 11+

> in plain language

You talk. It acts.

Simply state what you need in everyday language. Gotcha evaluates live device context and triggers the exact Android system operations required to complete your task.

“Text mom I'm running late”find_contactsend_sms

“How much space have I got left?”get_storage_info

“Set a random wallpaper”set_wallpaper

“What's on my screen right now?”read_screen

“Torch on, and turn the volume down to 30%”toggle_torchset_volume

“Open Spotify and start my liked songs”navigate_app

> two copilot modes

Monitor plans. Operator acts.

Gotcha runs as one of two copilot modes on your device. Switch modes instantly from the interface at any time.

Monitor40+ read-only tools

“Inspect & Plan”

Reads screen context, inspects device state, and analyzes information. It cannot send messages, alter settings, or delete files — ensuring zero-risk inspection.

OperatorAll 100+ tools

“Execute & Automate”

Performs direct actions across messages, calls, apps, media, and screen automation — fully bounded by explicit permissions you grant.

> visual feedback & permissions

Clear permissions & visual mode indicators

In call mode, Gotcha gives clear visual ring indicators: a Blue Ring means it is reading the screen and performing foreground operations, while an Orange Ring signals background processing. Actions are protected across 4 permission levels so you are always in control.

  1. Tier 0–1Everyday PermissionsBattery, storage status, phone dialer, opening apps
  2. Tier 2Personal AccessCalls, SMS, calendar events, location, camera access
  3. Tier 3Device AutomationScreen touch automation, notification reading, device admin
  4. Tier 4Privileged AccessRoot shell actions (strictly fails closed on unrooted devices)

Blue ring: Foreground & Screen ReadingOrange ring: Background OperationsExplicit permission gatesAppend-only audit logEncrypted on-device credentials

Read the full safety model →

> accessible over any app

The Assistive Ball

A floating companion accessible from anywhere on your phone. Long-press it — or just say “Hey Gotcha” — to start a push-to-talk voice call, where Gotcha sees your screen and acts on your behalf.

Example: Browsing Amazon and see a shirt you like on a model? Ask Gotcha to “find similar shirts to the one worn here.”Gotcha takes over the screen, searches the web, and presents matching products instantly.

How the Assistive Ball works →

Get Gotcha

Gotcha is available now as an APK on GitHub Releases, with in-app updates from then on. Sign in with Samosa AI for free starter credits, or bring your own local or cloud LLM.

content_html_zh:
设备上的 Android copilot · 现已推出

说出来，明白了。

大多数人工智能项目都会说话，但陷阱却会行动。 适用于 Android 的完全设备上 AI 副驾驶，可通过 100 多种工具将自然语言转化为真实的设备操作，让您完全掌控。

  • 完全在您的手机上运行
  • 自带模型（本地或云）
  • 免费 Samosa AI 积分即可开始
  • 安卓11+

> 用通俗易懂的语言

你说话。 它起作用了。

只需用日常语言陈述您的需求即可。 Gotcha 评估实时设备上下文并触发完成任务所需的确切 Android 系统操作。

“给妈妈发短信，我要迟到了”find_contactsend_sms

“我还剩下多少空间？”get_storage_info

“设置随机壁纸”set_wallpaper

“现在我的屏幕上有什么？”read_screen

“打开火炬，并将音量调低至 30%”toggle_torchset_volume

“打开 Spotify 并开始播放我喜欢的歌曲”navigate_app

> 两种副驾驶模式

监控计划。 操作员动作。

问题在您的设备上作为两种副驾驶模式之一运行。 随时从界面即时切换模式。

Monitor40+ 只读工具

“检查和计划”

读取屏幕上下文、检查设备状态并分析信息。 它无法发送消息、更改设置或删除文件——确保零风险检查。

Operator全部 100 多种工具

“执行和自动化”

跨消息、通话、应用程序、媒体和屏幕自动化执行直接操作 - 完全受您授予的显式权限的限制。

> 视觉反馈和权限

清晰的权限和可视化模式指示器

在通话模式下，Gotcha 提供清晰的视觉环指示符：蓝色环表示正在读取屏幕并执行前台操作，而橙色环则表示正在后台处理。 操作受到 4 个权限级别的保护，因此您始终处于掌控之中。

  1. 第 0–1 层日常权限电池、存储状态、电话拨号器、打开应用程序
  2. 第 2 层个人访问通话、短信、日历事件、位置、相机访问
  3. 第 3 层设备自动化屏幕触摸自动化、通知读取、设备管理
  4. 第 4 层特权 AccessRoot shell 操作（在未 root 的设备上严格关闭失败）

蓝环：前台和屏幕阅读橙环：后台操作显式权限门仅附加审核日志加密的设备上凭据

阅读完整的安全模型 →

> 可通过任何应用程序访问

辅助球

可通过手机随时随地访问的浮动伴侣。 长按它 - 或者只是说“嘿，Gotcha” - 即可启动按键通话语音通话，Gotcha 会看到您的屏幕并代表您采取行动。

示例：浏览亚马逊并看到模特身上有您喜欢的衬衫？ 让 Gotcha“找到与这里穿的类似的衬衫。”Gotcha 接管屏幕，搜索网络，并立即呈现匹配的产品。

辅助球的工作原理 →

明白了

Gotcha 现在可以在 GitHub Releases 上以 APK 形式提供，并从那时起提供应用内更新。 登录 Samosa AI 即可获得免费入门积分，或者携带您自己的本地或云 LLM。
